objective: Screen a four-anchor outer-FFN placement after the all-layer BF16-safe implementation exhausted causal memory, while preserving all-layer addressed/global RWKV attention routing.

authorization_basis.prior_outcome: The all-layer BF16-safe outer FFN produced finite nonzero gradients for all 504 tensors but exhausted a 40 GiB A100 during update 6 donor backward; no held-out rows were opened.
authorization_basis.architectural_response: Retain the attention-side addressed/global MoE on all 42 layers and place the post-MLP outer FFN only at depth anchors 10, 21, 31, and 41.

architecture.outer_ffn_placement: post_feedforward_layernorm hook at four decoder depth anchors, after each selected layer's frozen MLP and before its residual addition
architecture.zero_recurrent_identity: Zero recurrence is exactly projected-only in both paths; inactive outer-FFN layers are exact no-ops.

execution.distribution: one locked source/donor pair per rank; no gradient or optimizer update

stopping_rule.pass: Authorize a separately locked causal training run with 390 trainable tensors and the remaining open endpoint.
stopping_rule.failure: Archive the structural failure and do not open the endpoint.
stopping_rule.always: Do not open publisher validation/test, Hard32, the unused strength holdout, or native generation.
